rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for pausing because you are unsure about a decision or action.

example.english: I hesitate for a long time whenever I choose a course.
example.traditional: 我每次揀科都會猶豫好耐。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 ci3 gaan2 fo1 dou1 wui5 jau4 jyu6 hou2 noi6

rows.note: Use this colloquial expression when someone is wavering between choices and cannot make up their mind.

example.traditional: 你唔好再十五十六啦，快啲揀一個啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 sap6 ng5 sap6 luk6 laa1 faai3 di1 gaan2 jat1 go3 laa1

rows.jyutping: gong2 je5 zat6 haa5 zat6 haa5
rows.note: Use this specifically when someone falters or stammers while speaking.

example.english: When they get nervous, they hesitate and stammer.
example.traditional: 佢一緊張就講嘢窒吓窒吓。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 gan2 zoeng1 zau6 gong2 je5 zat6 haa5 zat6 haa5
